title: Make sure you check the Facetory site before you sub
text: I really live Facetory and I subscribe to their Lux plus box on their website.  My issue is that on Amazon they don’t say when the box for that month is out...so I was expecting the May and got the May welcome...which was not what I wanted. They stopped posting spoilers so I will probably stop subbing to this one.
label: negative
